{{short description|Swedish chemist}}

[[File:Krister english.jpg|thumbnail|Krister Holmberg]]
'''Krister Holmberg''', born 1946, is a Swedish [[chemist]].

Holmberg took a PhD in [[Organic Chemistry]] from [[Chalmers University of Technology]] in Gothenburg, Sweden in 1974. He then worked in industry for many years and he was R&D Director of Berol Nobel in Stenungsund, Sweden. During the period 1991-1998 he was Director of the [[Institute for Surface Chemistry]] in Stockholm. Since 1998 he has been Professor of Surface Chemistry at [[Chalmers University of Technology]]. His recent research has focussed on the behavior of surface active compounds in solution and at interfaces. He has been active in a number of industrial applications of surface and colloid chemistry.

Holmberg has been visiting professor at universities in the EU, the US and China: P. et M. Curie in Paris, the University of Florence, the University of California at Santa Barbara and the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Beijing. He is a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]] ''(Kungliga Ingenjörsvetenskapsakademien)'',<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.iva.se/globalassets/info-trycksaker/iva/iva-verksamhetsberattelse-2014.pdf|title = IVA verksamhetsberättelse 2014 (Swedish)|access-date = 2015-12-26|archive-date = 2016-01-05|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160105122717/http://www.iva.se/globalassets/info-trycksaker/iva/iva-verksamhetsberattelse-2014.pdf|url-status = dead}}</ref> of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] ''(Kungliga Vetenskapsakademin)''<ref>{{Cite web|title = Kungliga Vetenskapsakademien - Contact Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences|url = http://www.kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=2886|website = www.kva.se|access-date = 2015-12-26}}</ref> and of the [[Royal Society of Sciences and Letters in Gothenburg|Royal Academy of Arts and Sciences in Gothenburg]] ''(Kungliga Vetenskaps- och Vitterhetssamhället i Göteborg)''.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Kungliga Vetenskaps- och Vitterhetssamhället i Göteborg (KVVS)|url = http://www.kvvs.se/organisation.html|website = www.kvvs.se|access-date = 2015-12-26|url-status = dead|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160130072922/http://www.kvvs.se/organisation.html|archive-date = 2016-01-30}}</ref> He was chairman of the latter academy during 2014.

In 2000, Holmberg was awarded the French [[National Order of Merit (France)|National Order of Merit]] (''l'Ordre National du Mérite au grade de Chevalier''),<ref>{{Cite web|title = Krister Holmberg|url = https://www.chalmers.se/sv/personal/Sidor/Krister-Holmberg.aspx|website = www.chalmers.se|access-date = 2015-12-26}}</ref> and in 2006 he won the ''Oscar Carlson medal'' from the [[Swedish Chemical Society]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.chalmers.se/sv/nyheter/Sidor/medalj-till-krister-holmberg.aspx | title=Medalj till Krister Holmberg | publisher=[[Chalmers University of Technology]] | access-date=24 December 2015 | language=sv}}</ref> He received the [[Journal of Colloid and Interface Science|JCIS]] ''Life-Time Achievement Award''<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Krister Holmberg receives the JCIS Life-time Achievement Award|journal=Journal of Colloid and Interface Science|volume=328|pages=1–2|doi=10.1016/j.jcis.2008.09.053|year=2008}}</ref> in 2008, the ''Kash Mittal Award'' in 2018 and the ''Quancheng Friendship Award'' by the city of Jinan, China in 2019. In 2021 he received the Friendship Award of China from the Chinese Government.
